questions.text: Which objects does this change read or write, and which line proves the caller's tenant/owner matches?
Which permission key and scope gate each new route or tool, and is it declared as data in the registry? Is the public allowlist delta empty?
For every credential or copied ACL: how is it revoked, and what is the max staleness?
Does any input flow into a redirect, regex, shell, SQL or HTML? What bound or allowlist applies?
Am I implementing a protocol (OAuth/OIDC, webhook signature)? Which BCP section am I following, and which negative tests prove it?
What does an error from this path log? Could it include headers, URLs, configs or tokens?
What new listener, port, endpoint or container appears, and what is its default exposure?
Which artifacts leave the machine (PR text, screenshots, docs, transcripts), and were they scanned?
STRIDE, one line per changed data flow: who could spoof, tamper, read, deny or escalate here?

budgets.measure: route/tool inventory: entries neither gated nor in the public allowlist
sentinel secrets found in logs, artifacts and outputs after a test run
regex timing at the max accepted input length with a pumped attack string

rules.title: RegExp built from request or user input
rules.why: Regex injection and catastrophic backtracking on attacker-chosen patterns.
rules.confirm: measurement: pumped attack string at 1e3/1e4/1e5 grows super-linearly or breaks the budget
rules.fixHint: escape the input, bound its length, or use a linear engine

rules.title: Password on a command line or inside a connection string
rules.why: Visible to every local user in the process list and kept in shell history and transcripts (CWE-214).
rules.confirm: static-proof: the credential is in the command or file
rules.fixHint: read credentials from env or a password file

rules.title: Raw error/response/config object logged
rules.why: HTTP and DB client errors carry headers, URLs with keys and configs (CWE-532).
rules.confirm: failing-test: canary secret in env, force a provider error, grep outputs for the canary
rules.fixHint: log message, code and status only

rules.title: Compose service port published on all interfaces
rules.why: A dev database or metrics port reachable from the network, often with default credentials.

rules.title: Lookup by client-supplied id with no tenant/owner condition
rules.why: Another tenant's object is one id away (OWASP API1:2023).
rules.confirm: failing-test: two tenants; B's member requests A's id and gets 200

rules.title: New route/procedure/tool with no permission call and not in the public allowlist
rules.why: Anyone signed in (or anyone) can call it.
rules.confirm: failing-test: call it with a token lacking the permission; expect 403

rules.title: Authorization by role name (role === 'ADMIN', isAdmin) instead of the permission resolver
rules.why: Custom roles and scopes are bypassed or over-granted.
rules.confirm: failing-test: permission matrix property test finds an over- or under-grant

rules.title: Redirect target from request input without an origin compare
Token without expiry, or an ACL copied to another store with no update path
rules.confirm: failing-test: grant, use, revoke, reuse the same token -> still works

verify.tool: fitness test over the router registry

verify.text: two-tenant tests for each changed endpoint (1 positive, 2 negative)
revocation test per credential type and derived ACL
protocol negative tests (state, PKCE, redirect allowlist, webhook signature)

secret scan of the diff and every outbound artifact
